description: 固定事前采购量候选；复用旧来源程序结构，完整生成程序在执行前保存。
based_on: reports\research\510300_export_order_cause_increment_v1\01_外需字段来源与完整支持执行记录.json
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import json,re,hashlib,unicodedata
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
ROOT=Path.cwd();R='reports/research/510300_purchase_quantity_cause_increment_v1';OUT=ROOT/R
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def readj(p):return json.loads((ROOT/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
def save_new(name,value):
    p=OUT/name;assert not p.exists(),'已存在不覆盖：'+name
    p.write_text(json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
def norm(s):return re.sub(r'\s+','',unicodedata.normalize('NFKC',s)).replace('　','')
proto=readj(R+'/protocol_source.json')
for x in proto['parents']:assert sha(ROOT/x['path'])==x['sha256'],'来源父文件变化：'+x['path']
refs=readj('reports/research/510300_factor96_rapid_orders_inventory_v1/source_fields_and_anchors.json')
idx=pd.read_parquet(ROOT/'reports/research/510300_factor96_rapid_orders_inventory_v1/source_index.parquet')
old_orders=pd.read_parquet(ROOT/'reports/research/510300_macro_dynamic_reframe_v1/inputs/pmi_new_orders.parquet')
assert len(refs)==len(idx)==132
byidx={str(r.reference_period):r._asdict() for r in idx.itertuples(index=False)}
byold={str(r.reference_period):r._asdict() for r in old_orders.itertuples(index=False)}
assert len(byidx)==132
records=[]
for old in refs:
    month=old['stat_month'];p=ROOT/old['raw_path']
    assert sha(p)==old['raw_sha256']
    source=byidx[month];orig=byold[month]
    for k in ('raw_path','source_hash','available_at','published_at','first_release_value'):
        assert source[k]==orig[k],(month,k,'原月报来源不同')
    assert source['raw_path']==old['raw_path'] and source['source_hash']==old['raw_sha256']
    assert float(source['first_release_value'])==float(old['new_orders'])
    year,m=month.split('-');label=year+'年'+str(int(m))+'月'
    soup=BeautifulSoup(p.read_bytes(),'html.parser');matches=[]
    for ti,table in enumerate(soup.find_all('table')):
        rows=[[norm(c.get_text()) for c in tr.find_all(['td','th'])] for tr in table.find_all('tr')]
        headers=[r for r in rows[:5] if '采购量' in r and '进口' in r and '产成品库存' in r]
        if not headers:continue
        for header in headers:
            for ri,row in enumerate(rows):
                if row and row[0]==label:
                    assert len(row)==len(header),(month,'当前月表头长度不同',header,row)
                    col=header.index('采购量')
                    value=float(row[col]);assert 0<=value<=100
                    matches.append({'table_index':ti,'row_index':ri,'header':header,'current_month_row':row,'value_column':col,'value':value})
    assert matches and len({m['value'] for m in matches})==1,(month,'原当前月采购字段缺失/复制表不一致')
    records.append({'stat_month':month,'published_at':str(source['published_at']),
      'available_at':str(source['available_at']),'purchase_quantity':matches[0]['value'],
      'new_orders_same_source':float(old['new_orders']),'source_url':source['source_url'],
      'raw_path':old['raw_path'],'raw_sha256':old['raw_sha256'],
      'method_group':old['method_group'],'current_month_row_only':True,
      'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'anchors':matches})
records.sort(key=lambda x:x['stat_month'])
expected=[str(p) for p in pd.period_range('2015-01','2025-12',freq='M')]
assert [x['stat_month'] for x in records]==expected
values=pd.DataFrame([{k:v for k,v in r.items() if k!='anchors'} for r in records])
values['采购量水平']=values['purchase_quantity'].astype(float)
values['采购量月度变化']=values['采购量水平'].diff()
earlier=readj('reports/research/510300_historical_index_domestic_constraint_clock_v1/monthly_pmi.json')
lookup={r['stat_month']:r['purchase_quantity'] for r in records}
assert all(lookup[r['stat_month']]==r['purchases'] for r in earlier)
d=pd.read_parquet(ROOT/'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/纠错八变量历史输入及原标签.parquet')
assert np.array_equal(d.index.to_numpy(),d.idx.to_numpy())
original=d.copy(deep=True)
base=pd.read_csv(ROOT/'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/纠错8变量每日联合评分.csv')
base['date']=pd.to_datetime(base['date'])
assert len(base)==1212 and base.idx.is_unique
left=d[['idx','decision_time','orders_available_at','date']].copy()
left['decision_time']=pd.to_datetime(left['decision_time'],utc=True).astype('datetime64[ns, UTC]')
right=values[['available_at','stat_month','采购量水平','采购量月度变化']].copy()
right['采购来源可知时间']=pd.to_datetime(right.pop('available_at'),utc=True).astype('datetime64[ns, UTC]')
joined=pd.merge_asof(left.sort_values('decision_time'),right.sort_values('采购来源可知时间'),left_on='decision_time',right_on='采购来源可知时间',direction='backward').sort_values('idx')
assert np.array_equal(joined.idx.to_numpy(),d.idx.to_numpy())
added=['采购量水平','采购量月度变化']
for c in added:d[c]=joined[c].to_numpy(float)
d['采购来源可知时间']=joined['采购来源可知时间'].to_numpy()
d['采购统计月']=joined['stat_month'].to_numpy()
outside=d.date>pd.Timestamp('2025-12-31')
d.loc[outside,added]=np.nan
d.loc[outside,'采购来源可知时间']=pd.NaT
d.loc[outside,'采购统计月']=None
support=[];used=set()
for r in base.itertuples(index=False):
    i=int(r.idx)
    pool=d[(d.idx>=i-504)&(d.exit_idx<=i)&d.valid_features&d.net_label.notna()]
    assert len(pool)==int(r.n_train) and int(pool.exit_idx.max())==int(r.max_label_exit_idx)
    test=d.loc[[i]+pool.idx.astype(int).tolist()]
    finite=np.isfinite(test[added].to_numpy(float)).all()
    oldclock=pd.to_datetime(test.orders_available_at,utc=True).astype('datetime64[ns, UTC]')
    newclock=pd.to_datetime(test['采购来源可知时间'],utc=True).astype('datetime64[ns, UTC]')
    assert (oldclock.to_numpy()==newclock.to_numpy()).all(),(str(r.date),'同原订单来源时钟不同')
    assert (newclock.to_numpy()<=pd.to_datetime(test.decision_time,utc=True).to_numpy()).all()
    assert finite,(str(r.date),'原成员采购数据不完整，不删成员或拟合')
    assert np.isclose(float(d.net_label.iloc[i]),float(r.actual_net5),rtol=0,atol=1e-15)
    used.update(test['采购统计月'].tolist())
    support.append({'idx':i,'date':str(r.date),'original_mature_rows':len(pool),
     'added_complete_mature_rows':len(pool),'decision_fields_complete':True,
     'original_order_clock_matches':True,'max_label_exit_idx':int(pool.exit_idx.max())})
pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(d[original.columns],original,check_exact=True)
source_gate={'study_id':proto['study_id'],'checked_at':now(),
 'status':'PASS_EXISTING_CURRENT_MONTH_FIELDS_SAME_SOURCE_CLOCK_AND_ORIGINAL_TRAINING_SUPPORT_FIRST_VINTAGE_UNAUTHENTICATED',
 'raw_reports':132,'months':132,'added_fields':added,'original_score_dates':len(base),
 'original_mature_members_all_complete':True,'same_original_order_clock':True,
 'old_15_month_purchase_values_identical':True,'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,
 'evidence_scope':'旧官方当月行和旧公开时钟重构，适用于已声明探索性配对；不是已认证历史首次收件/独立验证或交易准入。',
 'field_missing_first_month_change':True,'first_change_needed_by_original_training_pool_missing':False,
 'statistics_methods':values.method_group.value_counts().to_dict(),'source_months_used_by_training_and_decisions':sorted(used),
 'new_source_requests':0,'new_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'new_full_accounts':0,
 'source_code_edits':0,'goal_achieved':False}
save_new('全部132月采购原文绑定.json',records)
values.to_parquet(OUT/'原公布采购月度字段.parquet',index=False)
values.to_csv(OUT/'原公布采购月度字段.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
d.to_parquet(OUT/'原八变量与采购两列_原标签不变.parquet',index=False)
pd.DataFrame(support).to_csv(OUT/'全部原评分与成熟成员支持.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
save_new('source_gate.json',source_gate)
save_new('prior_definition_review.json',{
 'status':'FIXED_DAILY_PURCHASE_CONDITION_USE_DISTINGUISHED_FROM_OLD_CPI_CONTEXT_AND_INVENTORY_RULES',
 'old_export_use':'旧15个月CPI背景描述，原CPI收益规则/国内扩展封存；本轮不是恢复该规则。',
 'old_inventory_use':'订单减库存及3个月变化固定32账户无候选；本轮不改其参数/字段营救。',
 'limited_code_search':'research/config/scripts中采购量直接用途命中仅旧国内时钟的字段解析；不宣称全仓所有文本/历史版本不存在用途。',
 'candidate_role':'原八变量相同每日成熟池，固定加采购量水平及月度变化来检查采购条件；非新物理来源或已经识别的国内订单。',
 'purchase_motive_causal_identification':False,'same_source_and_clock':True,
 'first_vintage_authenticated':False,'new_models_before_source_ready':0})
sourcepaths=['全部132月采购原文绑定.json','原公布采购月度字段.parquet','原八变量与采购两列_原标签不变.parquet','全部原评分与成熟成员支持.csv','source_gate.json','prior_definition_review.json']
model_proto={'study_id':proto['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E36','registered_at':now(),
 'status':'FIXED_ONE_EXPORT_CONDITION_MODEL_REGISTERED_BEFORE_NEW_PREDICTION',
 'source_protocol':R+'/protocol_source.json','source_gate':source_gate['status'],
 'source_stage_outputs':[{'path':R+'/'+p,'sha256':sha(OUT/p)} for p in sourcepaths],
 'parents':proto['parents'],'fixed_model_plan':proto['fixed_future_model_plan'],
 'controls':'复用原纠错八变量每日预测；共同成熟成员、原均值与标签逐日一致，不重新拟合控制。',
 'planned_new_fits':2424,'new_labels':0,'new_full_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,
 'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','orders_authorized':False,
 'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'goal_achieved':False,
 'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,
 'evidence_class':proto['evidence_class']}
assert model_proto['fixed_model_plan']==proto['fixed_future_model_plan']
save_new('protocol.json',model_proto)
for x in proto['parents']:assert sha(ROOT/x['path'])==x['sha256']
print(json.dumps({'采购原文月份':132,'原评分日':len(base),'原训练成员':'全部新增字段完整、时钟一致','旧15月值':'一致','历史首版':'未认证','固定模型':'来源后已登记，尚未拟合','新网络请求':0},ensure_ascii=False))
